Index nighttime lights files you already have

Source: R/files.R
ntl_files.Rd

Builds a manifest from local files so they can go through ntl_extract() like downloaded ones. Use it for products that ntlpanel cannot download (EOG VNL composites, harmonized DMSP-VIIRS series) and for Black Marble .h5 files downloaded elsewhere (for example with blackmarbler's h5_dir).

Usage

ntl_files(paths, product, period = NULL, series = NULL, recursive = TRUE)

Arguments

paths

Files and/or directories. Directories are searched for files matching the product's file_pattern (see ntl_sources()).

product

Product id from ntl_sources().

period

Optional periods, one per file, overriding the parsed ones.

series

Optional series name overriding the default.

recursive

Search directories recursively.

Value

An ntl_manifest data frame.

Details

Periods, platforms and tiles are parsed from file names:

  • Black Marble: VNP46A3.A2023001.h25v03.002.<production>.h5.

  • EOG monthly: SVDNB_<platform>_<YYYYMMDD>-<YYYYMMDD>_<tile>_...avg_rade9h.tif. The matching ...cf_cvg... file, if present in the same folder, is used as the observation-count layer. Each platform (npp, j01) becomes its own series, e.g. eog_vnl_monthly_npp.

  • EOG annual: VNL_[v22_]<platform>_<YYYY>_...average_masked...tif.

  • Harmonized series: the first four-digit year (1900-2099) in the name.

If a name cannot be parsed, pass period explicitly.

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
m <- ntl_files(ex$dir, "eog_vnl_monthly")
table(m$series)
#> 
#> eog_vnl_monthly_j01 eog_vnl_monthly_npp 
#>                  18                  36
